judgement.reason: Outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is reasonable; Meilisearch is an optional full-text search add-on and storage can use S3.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares meilisearch (getmeili/meilisearch:v1.13.3) in docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: Meilisearch is declared in the production compose file and the app depends on it with MEILI_HOST settings, and no shown line proves it is optional or unused in production, so Deployz cannot provide it and the vendor should confirm.
